Strategy: Apply the narrowed sweet-band reward between thirty-two and forty-two only when at least five bins are open, keeping the mid penalty always on. This combines a tighter target with the best gate, but the narrow band may trigger too rarely to matter.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (20 if len(bins) >= 5 and r - item >= 32 and r - item <= 42 else 0) - (20 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
